notes: Read whole. The three call sites + 0x1F, + 0x48 and + 0x63 all call the same callee (the listing resolves each to one address), cited by site. Paths: first call non-zero -> + 0x63; first zero and second 7 with `ecx` non-zero -> + 0x1F; first zero and second not 7 -> + 0x48. No doubts.
